description: This file defines a specification class 'CustomerOrdersWithItemsSpecification' that extends the Ardalis.Specification framework to query customer orders along with their associated items in the eShopOnWeb application.

classes.name: CustomerOrdersWithItemsSpecification
classes.description: A specification for fetching customer orders including order items and their details based on buyer ID.

methods.name: CustomerOrdersWithItemsSpecification
methods.description: Constructor that sets up the query to filter by buyerId and includes related order items and their detailed item information.
